newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - Ramco Energy Plc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - Ramco Energy Plc.

text.p: Total ADS to be offered N/A
ADSs offered by shareholders see note

Note: prior to the offerings, Stephen Remp, chairman and chief executive officer will exercise options to purchase 300,000 ordinary shares and sell such shares (in the form of ADSs or shares) in the offering. If the underwriters over-allotment is exercised, up to 300,000 additional shares will be sold.
Business: Based in Aberdeen, Scotland, Ramco is an independent energy company focused on the exploration and production of oil and gas in the former Soviet Union.

Use of Proceeds: will be used to primarily acquire interests in oil and gas prospects in the former Soviet Union and to fund the exploration, appraisal and development of such prospects and related infrastructure projects.
